target.title: fix(codex-supervisor): guard loadCodexSupervisorEndpoints JSON.parse against malformed env input
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/codex-supervisor/src/config.ts:170` calls bare `JSON.parse(raw)` in `loadCodexSupervisorEndpoints()` when parsing the `OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS` environment variable. If a user sets this env var to malformed JSON starting with `[`, a raw `SyntaxError` propagates uncaught instead of giving a clear validation error.

This follows the same pattern as merged D4 JSON.parse guard PRs: #97889, #97973, #97999, #98073, #98587, and the recently-approved #98800 (gateway live-helpers — also env var input).

## Changes

- `extensions/codex-supervisor/src/config.ts`: wrap `JSON.parse(raw)` in try/catch, throw descriptive `Error("OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS must be a valid JSON array.")` instead of raw SyntaxError
- `test/_proof_codex_supervisor_config_json_guard.mts`: standalone proof script that imports and calls the real `loadCodexSupervisorEndpoints()` with malformed env values

**Scope**: codex-supervisor config parsing only. Single call site, minimal change.

Label: bugfix | merge-risk: 🟢 minimal | AI-assisted

## Evidence

### Standalone proof script (L2) — imports the ACTUAL exported function

```
$ node --import tsx test/_proof_codex_supervisor_config_json_guard.mts

[1] malformed JSON array env → descriptive Error
  PASS  throws Error (not SyntaxError)
  PASS  message includes 'must be a valid JSON array'
  PASS  message includes env var name OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS

[2] valid JSON array env → returns correctly
  PASS  no error thrown
  PASS  returns array
  PASS  returns 1 endpoint

[3] empty env → returns default local endpoint
  PASS  no error thrown
  PASS  returns default 'local' endpoint

==================================================
  Passed: 8  Failed: 0  Total: 8
==================================================
```

Before: `JSON.parse("[NOT JSON")` → raw `SyntaxError` crashes supervisor startup
After: `loadCodexSupervisorEndpoints({ OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS: "[NOT JSON" })` → descriptive `Error: OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS must be a valid JSON array.`

### Call chain

Gateway startup → `loadCodexSupervisorEndpoints(process.env)` → reads `OPENCLAW_CODEX_SUPERVISOR_ENDPOINTS` → if starts with `[` → `JSON.parse(raw)` → validates each endpoint entry

### Negative control (L3)

Stashing the try/catch and reverting to bare `JSON.parse(raw)` causes proof test [1] to throw raw `SyntaxError` instead of descriptive `Error`, confirming the fix is real.
